title: Each Ask row says what it made, like "Drew a cat"
goal: Each row in the Agent area names what the request actually did in the person's own terms: "Drew a cat", "Made the cat's ears bigger", "Added 8 measurements to the toolbar". Today rows read "Drew a drawing", "Changed a layer" and "Drew 2 shapes", which tell the person nothing.
notes:
The user, 2026-10-20 15:32 (queue/audits/2026-10-20-user-ask-rows-undescriptive.png): 'i ask it to draw a cat but the agent history is undescriptive ... it should say "Drew a cat"'. Rows shown: Changed a layer; Drew a drawing (A later change builds on this.); Drew 2 shapes; Drew a drawing; Drew a drawing.

Cause, from code: AskChanges.sentence (Sources/PhotonzCore/AskChanges.swift:278) builds the row from the tool steps only. add_drawing maps to 'Drew a drawing' (:259) and only names a look when IllustrationBrief.make returns a brief, which it does not for a plain subject that is not a scene or an asked-for illustration (IllustrationBrief.swift:110-127), so 'a cat' falls back to 'a drawing'. set_layer is always 'Changed a layer' (:263). The request words (AskSession's asked) are never used.

The illustration task (an-illustration-ask-draws-looks-illustrated-natu) is running now and works in IllustrationBrief; pull before starting and build on what it left.
acceptance: Asking 'draw a cat' leaves a row that says 'Drew a cat'; a sun over mountains says 'Drew a sun over mountains'; an icon says 'Drew a smiley face icon'. The subject comes from the request or the drawing's own subject, never the word 'drawing' alone

A change to what is there names the thing and the change in plain words ('Made the cat's ears bigger', 'Recoloured the sky orange'), not 'Changed a layer'; when the words cannot be had, it at least names the layer ('Changed Cat Ear')
A row is at most about 40 characters, starts with a past-tense verb, and never shows a tool name, a layer count with no noun, or an em dash

Ways in, decide and log: the model writes a short summary with its plan (checked for length and form, with the rule-built sentence as the fallback), or the sentence is built from the request words and the layer names

Unit tests for the sentence rules over the eval's requests (every eval case's row is checked), and a walk with a picture of the rows in an audit under queue/audits/. Anything left rough is filed as a follow-up task if it clears the follow-up bar (queue/bin/follow-up-bar.md), and written into this task's log if it does not

log.note: Chose rule-built rows (request words past-tensed, the drawing's own subject, the changed layer's name) over the model's own summary because the local model's closing sentence varies run to run and cannot be checked over every eval case, while rules can; the model summary stays unused.

Review before building: a first-time user reads the row to find which request it was, so the person's own words beat a tool summary; risks were chatty requests (please, can you, thanks), questions, long sheet requests and drawing requests whose subject the model shortens. Each is a test in AskRowWordsTests.

Built: AskChangeWords moved to Sources/PhotonzCore/AskChangeWords.swift. sentence(steps, asked:, before:, after:): one described drawing keeps the person's words (cut at a natural break that still names the subject), steps that all name what they made (drawings, texts, titles, marks) use the rule words, anything else says the request back as done ('make the title bigger' -> 'Made the title bigger'; long asks for a thing cut to 'Made a component sheet'), and the fallback names the layers by name with a verb from what set_layer set (Recoloured, Resized, Moved, Hid, Flipped...). AskSession passes the request and both documents.

Verified: AskRowWordsTests (every climb-set eval case checked for form and subject; rows: Drew a cat/dog/bicycle..., Drew a city skyline at night, Drew a smiley face icon, Created a table, Made a component sheet, Made a pricing section on brand, Added 8 measurements). Full suite 14188 passed. Walk ask-rows-say-what-they-made-walk ok, 23 steps, Next defaults, real model: rows read 'Made the cat bigger' over 'Drew a cat'. Looked at both pictures (1-cat-row, 2-two-rows): the rows show those words. First walk run timed out on the second request while the full test suite ran beside it; rerun alone took 14s.

Rough items, none filed: measurements not saying where they went (stays here, nobody has asked); request said back even if the model did otherwise (a choice, in the audit for the user to react to); the walk timeout under load (not a defect, my own test run loaded the machine).

Rows in the Agent group name what a request made in the person's words: 'Drew a cat', 'Made the cat bigger', 'Drew a smiley face icon', 'Made a component sheet', and name the layer ('Resized Cat Ear') when the request is not an instruction.
